title: The Cold Debt
author: Ansel Oyelaran
blurb: Bram Reyes, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
